suggestions.message: For durable standalone receipts, include the harness and reviewed production SHA256 map directly in cosmetic/lifecycle evidence. The current native capture receipt does this, while cosmetic and lifecycle receipts rely on surrounding provenance. This review binds the current sources separately.

Consider explicit boundary-equality and replacement-accounting cases for both aggregate snapshot caps: exactly-at-limit acceptance, one-over rejection, and a later replacement freeing an earlier snapshot budget. Existing lowered-cap tests already prove transactional rejection.

summary: Passed independent S08-only diff/new-file review: no blocking security or logic defect found; 35 bounded headless focused tests passed with zero failures/errors/skips. No implementation edited, no commit/push, and no GL or full-suite execution performed.

review_scope.method: Reviewed git diff HEAD, complete changed production modules, all new S08 test/tool source, both docs, both complete example packs and the separate gameplay fixture. Parsed example payloads and exercised exact reproducibility, geometry preservation and install/provenance assertions. Also reviewed newly added tools/art/run_s08_gates.py: fresh-process serial modules, nonzero test/skip checks, process-group timeout and before/after input hashes.
checked: Contained path and symlink-loop/escape validation; special-file/nonblocking binary reads; bounded scans and payload reads; unsupported texture/material/executable content rejection.
Per-pack staging/rollback, committed identity/conflict bookkeeping, immutable all-LOD session snapshots, 240000-triangle and 32000000-encoded-byte aggregate limits.
Mesh/pack/material/LOD cache identities, session reset and CPU helper invalidation; renderer ownership and native lifecycle harness source reviewed without acquiring GL.
Effective loader-owned last-writer ship provenance, session gm.ds integration, explicit legacy default, no simulation/save/replay/checksum schema or compatibility-rule changes.

Test discovery/counts, exact per-tick full snapshots and checksum comparisons, nonvacuous commands and mesh differences, subprocess deadlines and cleanup; existing generic-preview assertions updated rather than weakened.
limitations: No independent native GL, screenshot visual assessment, live LAN/cosmetic worker rerun or full-suite run in this review; those remain owned by the parent.
Hostile concurrent filesystem races beyond documented containment/special-file protections were not treated as a new threat-model requirement.
No S09 native Windows, physical mixed-machine, packaging, performance, release, owner-art approval or default-activation acceptance is implied.
